'''Jason Makohon Ewoks''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Jason Makohon]], published on [[Torch Industries]].<ref name="torch">[http://members.aol.com/drtorch/Force.html Jason Makohon's Ewoks], Torch Industries (Paul Todd Feldman). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000303224657/http://members.aol.com:80/drtorch/Force.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Jason Makohon]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Torch Industries]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor: Chief Chirpa's Hut|Endor-L-endorchiefchirpashut.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Ewoks
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Makohon LS Ewoks Torch.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==
An Ewok deck that starts [[Endor: Chief Chirpa's Hut]], [[Jungle]] and [[Farm]]. Feldman called it "probably the most fun" deck on his page.<ref name="torch" />
